units: <cite ref="Shabbat 155b">Sabb. 155ᵇ</cite> <he>ופוֹקֵק</he> Ms. M., v. <cite ref="Q01496"><he>פָּקַס</he> I</cite>.—Denom. <cite ref="Q01516"><he>פֶּקֶק</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (denom. of פֶּקֶק; cmp. חָדַק a. חֶדֶק) to insert a stop-gap; to stop.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 3:8">Kel. III, 8</cite> <he>משפך … שפְּקָקוֹ וכ׳</he> (not <he>שפקקה</he>) a funnel of wood or clay stopped off with pitch.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 28:2">Ib. XXVIII, 2</cite> <he>שהתקינו לָפוֹק בו את המרחץ</he> (ed. Dehr. <he>לפַקֵּק</he>) (a shred) with which it was intended to fill up a gap in the bath. Y. Erub. III, end, 25ᵇ <he>צריך לפוק</he> he must stop it off. Tosef. ib. XI (VII), 10 <he>פּוֹקְקִין את הביב וכ׳</he> you may stop off a gutter with a cloth.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 17:3:2">Y. Sabb. XVII, 16ᵇ</cite> top <he>קנה שהתקינו להיות פּוֹקֵק בו החלון</he> a pole (with a coil or a board attached) which has been prepared to close the sky light with it; (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:3">Tosef. ib. XIV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:3">XV</cite>), 3 <he>להיות פותח ונועל בו</he>), v. <cite ref="Q01516"><he>פֶּקֶק</he></cite>. Bab.

<cite ref="Shabbat 64b:17">Sabb. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>פוקק לה זוג בצוארה וכ׳</he> he may muffle the bell on an animal’s neck (that it should not ring), and walk with it &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>פָּקוּק</he>; pl. <he>פְּקוּקִין</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 64b">Ib.</cite> <he>אע״פ שפ׳</he> nor should the animal be led out with a bell, even if it is muffled.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:20">Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵈ</cite> <he>מכוסה ואינו פ׳</he> if the bottle is covered but not stopped; <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 7:16">Tosef. Ter. VII, 16</cite> [read:] <he>מכוסין ואינן פקוקין</he> (and correct the entire passage in conformity with Y. l. c.), v. <cite ref="Q01516"><he>פֶּקֶק</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="Q01513">same</cite>, v. supra.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 1:5">Tosef. Maasr. I, 5</cite> <he>מפקק</he> ed. Zuck., v. <cite ref="Q01497"><he>פָּקַס</he> II</cite>.]

units: <cite ref="Berakhot 28b:18">Ber. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>שיִתְפַּקְּקוּ</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01511"><he>פִּקְפֵּק</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Aḥăré 8 <he>בשעה שנִתְפַּקְּקָה הכהונה וכ׳</he> when the priesthood in the hands of Aaron became shaky (was disputed); v. <cite ref="Q01511"><he>פִּקְפֵּק</he></cite>.
